title: +*INTRODUCTION TO CREATIVE NONFICTION WRITING
description: Analyzes creative nonfiction to develop a working knowledge of the creative nonfiction writer’s craft. Explores the human condition and its relationship to changing cultural contexts by reading, writing, and discussing works of creative nonfiction. Includes developing and revising creative nonfiction in a community of peer writers.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: WR 121Z, 121HZ, 121 or 121H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in WR 121Z, WR 121HZ, WR 121 and WR 121H.
